'''Rhea''' was the wife of [[Caar al Thorin al Toren]].

== History==
She lived around {{ab|1150}}. She met Caar al Thorin in the [[Borderlands]] but did not know who he was. They married. Their marriage led to Caar's death at Rhea's hands and the fall of [[Aleth-Loriel]]. She killed herself before his tomb.{{ref/book|1|19}}
